title: Auto-grid row height sizing for auto-fit panels with lower min height
answers: Why is there empty dead space below an auto-fit panel with a short min height?
How to prevent auto-grid rows from reserving extra height when panel minHeight is smaller than rowHeight?
How does AutoGridLayout calculate CSS grid autoRows when fitContent is enabled?
body:
Symptom: Auto-fit panels with a minimum height smaller than the row height leave unexpected empty dead space below them.
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridLayoutManager.tsx:getAutoRowsTemplate floored the CSS grid autoRows template at rowHeightPixels regardless of smaller minHeight settings.
Fix pattern: Floor the CSS grid autoRows track at Math.min(rowHeightPixels, getFitMinHeightInPixels(minHeight, rowHeight)) when fitContent is active, and set minHeight: rowHeightPx on non-fit item wrappers in public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/layout-auto-grid/AutoGridItemRenderer.tsx:AutoGridItemRenderer.
Constraints: Applies when fitContent is enabled and fillScreen is disabled; does not affect layouts without auto-height panels or where fillScreen is active.
applies: Grafana dashboard auto-grid layout row sizing and content fitting.
